_meta.note: The demo seller (Kiln & Clay Studio, Portland OR) shop records and inbox, keyed by PayPal invoice number. Sample data, labelled as such in the UI. Lines dated after the app clock are hidden. DD-SPIKE-* entries belong to the early spike orders.

MUG-SET-4.title: Speckled ceramic mug set (4)
MUG-SET-4.text: Set of 4 handmade ceramic mugs, 12 oz each, speckled white glaze. Ships in a double-walled box.

KC-BOWL-10.title: Hand-thrown serving bowl, 10 in
KC-BOWL-10.text: Wheel-thrown stoneware serving bowl, 10 in across, glossy indigo glaze. Food and dishwasher safe. Ships signature-required in a double box.

KC-PLATE-6.title: Matte glaze dinner plates, set of 6
KC-PLATE-6.text: Six 10.5 in stoneware dinner plates in matte oat glaze. Each plate is handmade, so sizes vary slightly.

KC-MUG-4.title: Speckled stoneware mugs, set of 4
KC-MUG-4.text: Four 12 oz speckled stoneware mugs. Handmade: small glaze variations and speckles are part of the look. Ships wrapped individually.

KC-PLANTER.title: Ceramic planter with drainage tray
KC-PLANTER.text: 6 in ceramic planter with drainage hole and matching tray, satin white glaze.

KC-VASE.title: Small bud vase, celadon
KC-VASE.text: 4 in bud vase in celadon glaze.

KC-PLATTER-3.title: Serving platter set of 3, hand-glazed
KC-PLATTER-3.text: Three nesting stoneware serving platters (14, 12 and 10 in), hand-glazed in sea-salt white.

KC-DINNER-16.title: Stoneware dinnerware set, 16 pieces
KC-DINNER-16.text: Service for 4: dinner plates, side plates, bowls and mugs in speckled oat glaze. Handmade, so each piece varies slightly in size and speckle.

KC-CAFE-24.title: Café order: 24 espresso cups, wholesale
KC-CAFE-24.text: Wholesale order of 24 handmade 3 oz espresso cups with saucers for cafés.
